v.t: Qaf. By the Glorious Quran
v.l: Qaf Wa Al-Qur'ani Al-Majidi

v.t: They marveled that a warner has come to them from among them. The disbelievers say, “This is something strange
v.l: Bal `Ajibu 'An Ja'ahum Mundhirun Minhum Faqala Al-Kafiruna Hadha Shay'un `Ajibun

v.t: When we have died and become dust? This is a farfetched return.”
v.l: A'idha Mitna Wa Kunna Turabaan Dhalika Raj`un Ba`idun

v.t: We know what the earth consumes of them, and with Us is a comprehensive book
v.l: Qad `Alimna Ma Tanqusu Al-'Arđu Minhum Wa `Indana Kitabun Hafizun

v.t: But they denied the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state
v.l: Bal Kadhabu Bil-Haqqi Lamma Ja'ahum Fahum Fi 'Amrin Marijin

v.t: Have they not observed the sky above them, how We constructed it, and decorated it, and it has no cracks
v.l: Afalam Yanzuru 'Ila As-Sama'i Fawqahum Kayfa Banaynaha Wa Zayyannaha Wa Ma Laha Min Furujin

v.t: And the earth, how We spread it out, and set on it mountains, and grew in it all kinds of delightful pairs
v.l: Wa Al-'Arđa Madadnaha Wa 'Alqayna Fiha Rawasiya Wa 'Anbatna Fiha Min Kulli Zawjin Bahijin

v.t: A lesson and a reminder for every penitent worshiper
v.l: Tabsiratan Wa Dhikra Likulli `Abdin Munibin

v.t: And We brought down from the sky blessed water, and produced with it gardens and grain to harvest
v.l: Wa Nazzalna Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Mubarakaan Fa'anbatna Bihi Jannatin Wa Habba Al-Hasidi

v.t: And the soaring palm trees, with clustered dates
v.l: Wa An-Nakhla Basiqatin Laha Tal`un Nađidun

v.t: As sustenance for the servants. And We revive thereby a dead town. Likewise is the resurrection
v.l: Rizqaan Lil`ibadi Wa 'Ahyayna Bihi Baldatan Maytaan Kadhalika Al-Khuruju

v.t: Before them the people of Noah denied the truth, and so did the dwellers of Russ, and Thamood
v.l: Kadhabat Qablahum Qawmu Nuhin Wa 'Ashabu Ar-Rassi Wa Thamudu

v.t: And Aad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot
v.l: Wa `Adun Wa Fir`awnu Wa 'Ikhwanu Lutin

v.t: And the Dwellers of the Woods, and the people of Tubba. They all rejected the messengers, so My threat came true
v.l: Wa 'Ashabu Al-'Aykati Wa Qawmu Tubba`in Kullun Kadhaba Ar-Rusula Fahaqqa Wa`idi

v.t: Were We fatigued by the first creation? But they are in doubt of a new creation
v.l: Afa`ayina Bil-Khalqi Al-'Awwali Bal Hum Fi Labsin Min Khalqin Jadidin

v.t: We created the human being, and We know what his soul whispers to him. We are nearer to him than his jugular vein
v.l: Wa Laqad Khalaqna Al-'Insana Wa Na`lamu Ma Tuwaswisu Bihi Nafsuhu Wa Nahnu 'Aqrabu 'Ilayhi Min Habli Al-Waridi

v.t: As the two receivers receive, seated to the right and to the left
v.l: Idh Yatalaqqa Al-Mutalaqqiyani `Ani Al-Yamini Wa `Ani Ash-Shimali Qa`idun

v.t: Not a word does he utter, but there is a watcher by him, ready
v.l: Ma Yalfizu Min Qawlin 'Illa Ladayhi Raqibun `Atidun

v.t: The daze of death has come in truth: “This is what you tried to evade.”
v.l: Wa Ja'at Sakratu Al-Mawti Bil-Haqqi Dhalika Ma Kunta Minhu Tahidu

v.t: And the Trumpet is blown: “This is the Promised Day.”
v.l: Wa Nufikha Fi As-Suri Dhalika Yawmu Al-Wa`idi

v.t: And every soul will come forward, accompanied by a driver and a witness
v.l: Wa Ja'at Kullu Nafsin Ma`aha Sa'iqun Wa Shahidun

v.t: “You were in neglect of this, so We lifted your screen from you, and your vision today is keen.”
v.l: Laqad Kunta Fi Ghaflatin Min Hadha Fakashafna `Anka Ghita'aka Fabasaruka Al-Yawma Hadidun

v.t: And His escort will say, “This is what I have ready with me.”
v.l: Wa Qala Qarinuhu Hadha Ma Ladayya `Atidun

v.t: “Throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever
v.l: Alqiya Fi Jahannama Kulla Kaffarin `Anidin

v.t: Preventer of good, aggressor, doubter
v.l: Manna`in Lilkhayri Mu`tadin Muribin

v.t: Who fabricated another god with God; toss him into the intense agony.”
v.l: Al-Ladhi Ja`ala Ma`a Allahi 'Ilahaan 'Akhara Fa'alqiyahu Fi Al-`Adhabi Ash-Shadidi

v.t: His escort will say, “Our Lord, I did not make him rebel, but he was far astray.”
v.l: Qala Qarinuhu Rabbana Ma 'Atghaytuhu Wa Lakin Kana Fi Đalalin Ba`idin

v.t: He will say, “Do not feud in My presence—I had warned you in advance
v.l: Qala La Takhtasimu Ladayya Wa Qad Qaddamtu 'Ilaykum Bil-Wa`idi

v.t: The decree from Me will not be changed, and I am not unjust to the servants.”
v.l: Ma Yubaddalu Al-Qawlu Ladayya Wa Ma 'Ana Bizallamin Lil`abidi

v.t: On the Day when We will say to Hell, “Are you full?” And it will say, “Are there any more?”
v.l: Yawma Naqulu Lijahannama Hal Amtala'ti Wa Taqulu Hal Min Mazidin

v.t: And Paradise will be brought closer to the pious, not far away
v.l: Wa 'Uzlifati Al-Jannatu Lilmuttaqina Ghayra Ba`idin

v.t: “This is what you were promised—for every careful penitent
v.l: Hadha Ma Tu`aduna Likulli 'Awwabin Hafizin

v.t: Who inwardly feared the Most Gracious, and came with a repentant heart
v.l: Man Khashiya Ar-Rahmana Bil-Ghaybi Wa Ja'a Biqalbin Munibin

v.t: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity.”
v.l: Adkhuluha Bisalamin Dhalika Yawmu Al-Khuludi

v.t: Therein they will have whatever they desire—and We have even more
v.l: Lahum Ma Yasha'una Fiha Wa Ladayna Mazidun

v.t: How many generations before them, who were more powerful than they, did We destroy? They explored the lands—was there any escape
v.l: Wa Kam 'Ahlakna Qablahum Min Qarnin Hum 'Ashaddu Minhum Batshaan Fanaqqabu Fi Al-Biladi Hal Min Mahisin

v.t: In that is a reminder for whoever possesses a heart, or cares to listen and witness
v.l: Inna Fi Dhalika Ladhikra Liman Kana Lahu Qalbun 'Aw 'Alqa As-Sam`a Wa Huwa Shahidun

v.t: We created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days, and no fatigue touched Us
v.l: Wa Laqad Khalaqna As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Wa Ma Baynahuma Fi Sittati 'Ayyamin Wa Ma Massana Min Lughubin

v.t: So endure what they say, and proclaim the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun, and before sunset
v.l: Fasbir `Ala Ma Yaquluna Wa Sabbih Bihamdi Rabbika Qabla Tulu`i Ash-Shamsi Wa Qabla Al-Ghurubi

v.t: And glorify Him during the night, and at the end of devotions
v.l: Wa Mina Al-Layli Fasabbihhu Wa 'Adbara As-Sujudi

v.t: And listen for the Day when the caller calls from a nearby place
v.l: Wa Astami` Yawma Yunadi Al-Munadi Min Makanin Qaribin

v.t: The Day when they will hear the Shout in all truth. That is the Day of Emergence
v.l: Yawma Yasma`una As-Sayhata Bil-Haqqi Dhalika Yawmu Al-Khuruji

v.t: It is We who control life and death, and to Us is the destination
v.l: Inna Nahnu Nuhyi Wa Numitu Wa 'Ilayna Al-Masiru

v.t: The Day when the earth will crack for them at once. That is an easy gathering for Us
v.l: Yawma Tashaqqaqu Al-'Arđu `Anhum Sira`aan Dhalika Hashrun `Alayna Yasirun

v.t: We are fully aware of what they say, and you are not a dictator over them. So remind by the Quran whoever fears My warning
v.l: Nahnu 'A`lamu Bima Yaquluna Wa Ma 'Anta `Alayhim Bijabbarin Fadhakkir Bil-Qur'ani Man Yakhafu Wa`idi
